game_title: Name Tag Match – Moat Bridge Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing arrows before they reach rogue crows.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing arrows before they reach rogue crows. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the granary door using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the granary door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The granary door reached with actions_used <= 18.
